I shipped two changes to the downed screen (34). The critic still scores it 2, so this task is partial.

- **v31.28 `cw-downplate`:** the downed block (word "down", bar, timer, prompt) now sits on one dark panel instead of on the red wash.
- **v31.34 `cw-downplate2`:** the timer has its own centred row under the word "down", and everything stacks in one centred column. The panel is 480 wide. I haven't re-checked the surrender line under the prompt. It didn't show in the last shot, probably because of the give-up setting.

Both passed preflight and shipped. I logged the change in `notes\ui\changes.md`. No text changed, so no ruling of his is touched.

The critic's remaining P0s on screen 34 are outside what I could take:
- **Top-right bars:** the credits/xp/stash/backpack bars wait on `cw-trcol`, so I skipped them.
- **Right column collisions:** the pickup feed lands on the last run-info contract line, and the "extraction available" chip hides under the "concealed" tag. This is in 02's area.
- **Left feed:** the critic says it duplicates the right feed. I didn't touch it.

Lower-priority critic findings I left alone:
- The downed panel doesn't share the other panels' border style.
- The bottom-left "down" tag is redundant with the centre panel.

- **Screens judged:** I ran the critic on the never-judged 20, 34 and 36, but only fixed 34. I did not get to 24, 51 or 78.
- **Notes:** details are in `notes\b-30-ui-hud.md`, and the new shots are in `shots\b-30e` and `shots\b-30g-after`.

TASK PARTIAL: screen 34 still scores 2; the right-column overlap and the left/right feed duplication remain, and 24, 51 and 78 are still unjudged.
